hook: Floodwater over a truck, and someone still on the roof.
narration: This truck was almost underwater, and someone was still on top of it.
This was near Rosburg, Washington, and the floodwater was moving fast.
An Astoria Jayhawk crew was headed to four people trapped in a house, with four feet of water around it.
Then the crew was diverted to this truck.
A rescue swimmer rides the cable down in a harness, then clips the survivor in for the ride back up.
The swimmer and the survivor went up together, swinging over the flood.
Next, the crew hoisted all four people out of the house.
outcome: All five reached Air Station Astoria in stable condition.
title: Stuck on a truck roof in a flood
description:
A Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk aircrew from Air Station Astoria hoisted a person off a truck in floodwater, then four people from a flooded home, near Rosburg, Washington, on Dec. 5, 2023.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard courtesy video, U.S. Coast Guard Northwest, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/906547/coast-guard-rescues-5-people-flooding-near-grays-river-washington
